name: Think Shape
strapline: fashion app empowering people to buy less and buy better
title: Think Shape: empowering people to buy less and buy better

content.text: Renowned fashion stylist Anna Berkeley wanted to scale her 25 years of expertise and make her unique styling method accessible to a global audience. Her manual process, honed through her work with Selfridges and the Financial Times, was proven but limited in its reach.

On behalf of the agency I co-founded, we were brought on to translate her proven methodology into a scalable, user-friendly mobile app. The goal was to build a digital product that could codify her knowledge, guide users through a personal measurement process, and deliver bespoke clothing recommendations, ultimately creating a new commercial venture for her brand.

The first and most critical challenge was to deconstruct and digitize Anna's deep, nuanced understanding of body shapes and clothing styles. This began with a series of intensive workshops to map out her entire system, which existed primarily in a complex Excel spreadsheet and her own experience.

We worked closely with Anna to transcribe her logic into a detailed specification. This involved converting decades of styling intuition into a clear set of programmable rules that would form the core algorithm of the application. This foundational work was essential to ensure the app's recommendations would be genuinely authentic to her method.

With the logic defined, we designed and built the technical architecture to support it. The core algorithm was developed as a high-performance API using Go, chosen for its speed and efficiency in handling the complex calculations.

For the app itself, we used React Native to deliver a consistent, polished experience across both iOS and Android from a single codebase. A key decision was to power the entire system with a headless CMS. This decouples the content from the presentation, empowering the Think Shape team to update styling advice, add new clothing types, and manage all in-app text without requiring developer intervention.

The result is a highly-rated app on iOS and Android that successfully translates a world-class stylist’s brain into a scalable digital product, now serving thousands of monthly active users. The Go API reliably executes the core logic, while the headless CMS gives the client full control over their content.

We delivered a robust, commercially successful platform that not only met the client's vision but also provided a flexible foundation for future growth. The project stands as a strong example of our agency's ability to handle complex client requirements and transform a non-technical, expert-led service into a thriving digital business.
